description: Zero-shot identity holdout for complementary two-sender communication
research_question: Can a symbol protocol learned by residents be used by a same-type newcomer with no social communication training?
endpoint_intervention: For each schedule and held identity, replace only that identity's receiver, food-sender or water-sender model in the one team where it has that role; all other role models remain resident models.
primary_unit: seed×panel, averaged over four held identities and three panels within seed
limits: This is a zero-shot endpoint identity probe, not online newcomer adaptation.
The newcomer shares the resident private encoder type but has freshly reset communication modules.
The test evaluates grounded readout and token compatibility; it does not establish cultural transmission or a population-wide lexicon.
